create_PPO: create a PPO reinforcement learning agent with an actor-critic network and configurable clip, epoch, and batch parameters
update_PPO: update the PPO agent by running multiple epochs of mini-batch policy optimization on a rollouts object
get_advantages_PPO: get normalized or raw advantages from rollouts by subtracting value predictions from returns
run_PPO_update: run PPO policy updates with clipped surrogate objectives, value loss, and entropy regularization
review_PPO_before_step: review the PPO before_step hook that clips gradient norms on actor-critic parameters before optimizer step
